posts.title: Ergonomic SSH development
posts.description: I’ve been setting up a dev machine on my home server and doing all of my personal projects remotely over SSH . I’ve fiddled quite a bit with the system to make it ergonomic, so here are some of the things I’m quite happy with. Tmux autocompletions Of course, tmux is a t-must! One of the cool things about tmux is that you can programmatically read the contents of a pane via tmux capture-pane -S- -p
